name: Gw Lovers
summary:
"Gw Lovers" is a captivating VR game designed to immerse players in a tranquil yet engaging environment. Set in a serene virtual world filled with lush landscapes, calming music, and picturesque scenery, the game offers a unique experience of relaxation and creativity.
The objective of Gorilla Tagged is simple yet delightful: players use virtual reality tools to create beautiful, glowing art installations throughout the game world.
